title: Q: What model to use on Claude Code + Unreal Engine 5.8
author: slimsheikki
selftext:
Fairly simple question which probably opens up larger discussions. But I'm interested in learning to be more efficient in vibe coding. I'm currently using Claude Code in UE 5.8 and I'm struggling to be sure what model to use and when.

I started by planning with Haiku and sometimes Sonnet, and started to work on a prototype with Sonnet 5. I started to implement multiplayer features and decided to switch it to Opus 5 because my brain just immediately thinks it would require deeper thinking and higher effort to manage multiplayer implementation. I'm now just burning so much tokens that I'm not sure if I should switch it back to Sonnet 5 and try to implement some of the features with it.

Any tips and tricks to being efficient with Claude Code + Unreal Engine are extremely welcome.

Note, I'm (Claude is) also working with Blueprints.

comments.author: Mrdifi
comments.body: do this use claude + codex claude with design and codex for making blueprints.
